# Marinaccio Law

> > Marinaccio Law provides comprehensive legal services in Glendale and Los Angeles, specializing in real estate law, landlord-tenant disputes, estate planning, and civil litigation.

Led by attorney Anthony Marinaccio, the firm focuses on California real estate transactions, evictions (including Ellis Act and rent control matters), probate administration, and business contract disputes. The practice serves clients throughout Los Angeles County with particular expertise in the Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance and tenant rights.

## Key Topics

- Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (LARSO)
- Ellis Act evictions
- Unlawful detainer proceedings
- Estate planning and probate
- Landlord-tenant law
- Rent control regulations
- Tenant rights and relocation assistance
- Real estate transactions
- Civil litigation
- Breach of contract
- Glendale legal services
- Los Angeles Housing Department
- Gentrification impacts
- COVID-19 rental protections
- California property law
